turns.customer: The seam tape inside my Squall rain jacket (order #1127) is peeling and it leaks at the shoulders now. I bought it in early June. What can I do?
turns.reply: I've handed this to a warranty team member, and they'll follow up by email, usually within one business day. Your ticket number is ESC-2. In the meantime, hold onto the jacket and ideally some photos of the peeling seam tape, since that will speed things along. Is there anything else I can help with?
